text.description_html:
Emtek BTB-86439, Rustic Modern Farmhouse Back-To-Back Door Handle Pair

Thanks to the Sandcast Bronze material from which it is made, the Farmhouse 8 Inch Back-to-Back Pull Set has a timelessness to its contemporary design, allowing you to create an eclectic space that reflects your personality. The Rustic Modern Farmhouse Back-To-Back Door Handle Pair will fit doors 1-3/8 inches to 2-1/4 inches thick. It comes packaged as a pair of 2 pulls and all the necessary mounting hardware. Emtek's Rustic Modern Pulls Pair is available in matte black, medium bronze, and tumbled white bronze finishes.

Sandcasting is a process for casting metal in sand molds. The mold is made by packing the sand around a pattern. Molten bronze is then poured into a mold cavity formed out of sand. Each sand mold is used only once. The sand is then recycled for the next piece.

Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Packaged with 2 door pulls (1 door pull for each side of a door).

Also Available: Farmhouse Pull with Thru-Bolt Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek Rustic Modern Sandcast Bronze Pull:

  • Material: Sandcast Bronze
  • Total Length: 8-1/2"
  • Center to Center Length: 8"
  • Pull Handle Width: 1"
  • Total Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Base: 13/16"
  • Door Thickness: for doors 1-3/8" to 2-1/4" thick.
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.

Sold as a Pair (2 Door Pulls) with Back-to-Back mounting.
